title: Implement dependency vulnerability and dependency-diff controls
objective: Add bounded zero-cost dependency security controls by reusing the existing pinned pip-audit toolchain for the current Python lock and adding an exact-SHA GitHub Dependency Review gate for newly introduced dependencies.

required_invariants: requirements-dev.in and pyproject dev dependencies remain exact-version equivalent
requirements-dev.txt remains a one-line reference to requirements-dev.lock
every requirements-dev.lock package remains exact-version pinned with no VCS URL editable or floating specifier
pip-audit version remains the already locked 2.9.0 during this AWU
GitHub Dependency Review is pinned to exact v5.0.0 commit
dependency review fails from low severity across runtime development and unknown scopes
dependency-review PR comments and warn-only mode remain disabled
routine non-dependency commits do not trigger the dedicated dependency workflow
weekly/current-lock auditing requires no paid API SaaS LLM or larger runner
acceptance_criteria: static validator proves direct dev dependency parity and lock exactness
dependency workflow is path-filtered to dependency/control files plus weekly/manual execution
current lock audit runs pip-audit against requirements-dev.lock
pull requests additionally execute dependency-review-action v5.0.0 pinned at a1d282b36b6f3519aa1f3fc636f609c47dddb294
dependency review uses fail-on-severity low and fail-on-scopes runtime,development,unknown
workflow has contents read only and no PR write permission
current dependency lock passes live audit or produces a fail-closed vulnerability finding

done_when: current lock is vulnerability-audited by the dedicated bounded workflow
new PR dependency changes are checked by exact-SHA GitHub Dependency Review
dependency manifests and direct dev pins cannot silently drift
dependency security path remains zero-cost and does not run on unrelated commits
